description: REQ-R6 opens with 'writes SHALL follow REQ-R5-equivalent ordering' — this is a broken self-reference. REQ-R5 (in this same spec) is the dedup rule, not an ordering rule. The intended reference is presumably feature (b) earn-roi-reconciler REQ-R5 (which does specify build→write→append→state→offset ordering, verified at `.vcsdd/features/earn-roi-reconciler/specs/behavioral-spec.md:60-75`). As it stands, an implementer reading only this spec cannot resolve the reference and must inspect a sibling feature's spec — brittle. Fix: either inline the ordering steps (which REQ-R6 (i)-(v) already does — so the phrase is redundant and misleading) or explicitly cite the sibling: 'per earn-roi-reconciler REQ-R5 ordering discipline'.

evidence.snippet: REQ-R6: writes SHALL follow REQ-R5-equivalent ordering: (i) build in-memory settle-rows-to-append, (ii) append to settle.jsonl ...
